52_week_high.disagreement_note: equitypandit's historical-data series implied a slightly higher 52w high of ~32,538 around late Aug 2025. Given three independent sources agree on 31,998 and only one diverges (and that one's date-tagging for other stats was found to be unreliable/possibly stale, see 52-week low note), 31,998 is treated as primary.

52_week_low.disagreement_note: equitypandit's series implied a low of ~18,670.90 around 24 Mar 2026, about 1% higher than the 18,500.35 consensus figure. indmoney separately tagged the high/low with dates of Aug 2024 / Apr 2024, which fall outside any 52-week window as of Jul 2026 and are judged stale/leftover metadata, not evidence against the 31,998/18,500 values themselves (which indmoney's own headline numbers match).

drawdown_from_52w_high_pct.note: Using the alternate equitypandit high of 32,538: (18853-32538)/32538 = -42.06%. Both computations point to the stock trading roughly 41-42% below its 52-week high.

52_week_price_change_pct.computation: (18853.00 - 25398.95) / 25398.95 = -0.2577, using equitypandit historical close of Rs 25,398.95 on 2026-07-09's prior-year same calendar date (2025-07-09)
52_week_price_change_pct.disagreement_note: Using 2025-07-10 close (Rs 25,018) instead gives -24.64%. A separate, differently-dated snapshot (5paisa search result, 'as of 07 May 2026') stated the stock was down 7.13% over the trailing year to that date — not directly comparable since the reference date differs by ~2 months, but flagged to show how much the reported 1-year change swings depending on snapshot date for this illiquid, high-volatility name. Best estimate: approximately -25% to -26% over the trailing 12 months to 2026-07-09.

latest_reported_quarter.source: screener.in quarterly results table; announcement date from scanx.trade article
latest_reported_quarter.note: Revenue/net-loss driven by net loss on fair-value changes of financial-asset investments (this is an NBFC/investment holding company, so 'revenue' includes mark-to-market gains/losses on its equity and mutual-fund portfolio, not operating sales).

revenue_growth_yoy_mrq_pct.caveat: Both base and current-period revenue are negative (mark-to-market driven), so a standard %-growth figure is not economically meaningful — it mechanically reflects that losses widened, not a revenue decline in the usual operating sense.

earnings_growth_yoy_mrq_pct.caveat: Same caveat as revenue growth — both quarters are loss-making; the negative-base % is directionally 'losses widened YoY' rather than a clean growth-rate comparison.

roe_latest_fy_pct.disagreement_note: screener also separately shows a 3-year-average ROE of 5.30% (reflecting the profitable FY24/FY25 years before FY26's loss). ticker.finology.in shows ROE of 3.7%, which does not match either screener figure precisely — likely a differently-windowed or differently-computed (e.g. trailing-period-average) ROE. Flagged as a disagreement rather than reconciled.

promoter_holding_pct.source: screener.in, ticker.finology.in, indmoney.com — all three agree exactly

notes: This is a very thinly-traded, illiquid BSE-only small-cap NBFC/investment holding company (share price ~Rs 18,800, only 150,000 shares outstanding, ~3,051 shareholders). Aggregator sites frequently disagree by small-to-moderate margins and some carry visibly stale cached data (e.g. indmoney's 52-week high/low date tags from 2024, several sites still quoting the prior Rs 25 dividend instead of the latest Rs 35 paid dividend). Where sources disagreed, the disagreement is noted per-field above rather than silently resolved.

The company's 'revenue' and 'net profit' lines are dominated by fair-value gains/losses on its investment portfolio (shares, mutual funds), not operating sales — this makes YoY revenue/earnings growth percentages, especially quarter-over-quarter, prone to large and not-very-meaningful swings when the base period is also negative.

P/E TTM is not meaningful because trailing-12-month EPS is negative (FY26 full-year loss of Rs 216/share), driven almost entirely by a large mark-to-market loss in the Mar-2026 quarter (EPS -2,094 that quarter alone).

A dividend of Rs 25/share for FY2025-26 has been recommended by the board (record date 18-Aug-2026, AGM 25-Aug-2026) but is NOT YET PAID as of this pack's compilation date (2026-07-10) — it is excluded from the trailing-12-month 'paid' dividend total and listed separately under declared-not-yet-paid.
Company is BSE-listed only (code 509470); it is not listed on NSE, despite many aggregator page titles generically saying 'NSE/BSE'.
ISIN INE01TL01014 was corroborated across three independent sources (Upstox, Cbonds, MarketScreener) plus the search-engine snippet; no source contradicted it.

This pack was compiled entirely from live web sources (screener.in, finology, indmoney, stockanalysis.com, equitypandit, trendlyne, scanx.trade, upstox, cbonds, marketscreener); no localhost or Vysted internal API was queried.
